plan.goal: Make PacketLease ownership generation-safe and allocation-free after warm-up across all baseline consumers.
acceptance: Implement the exact readonly generational handle, non-wrapping token and intrusive state-pool contract.
Migrate staging, framing, transport and history compile-atomically to explicit ref-transfer/default ownership.
Remove PacketLease.Memory and document borrowed Span and aggregate ReadOnlyMemory lifetimes.
Prove invalid/stale/double ownership failures and forced generation exhaustion without alias revival.
Prove warmed Rent/Dispose and Rent/Transfer/Dispose loops allocate zero managed bytes in isolated tests.
Preserve the existing wire format, protocol behavior and transport lifecycle semantics.

riskToTest.risk: A copied or transferred handle returns or revives pooled storage twice
Ownership migration leaks or duplicates leases across aggregates and queues
riskToTest.test: Focused staging, framing, history and transport transfer regression matrix

riskToTest.risk: The lease optimization still allocates one managed wrapper per packet
riskToTest.test: Isolated warmed Rent/Dispose and Rent/Transfer/Dispose allocation loops
